tagline: Global leader in the design, manufacture and distribution of branded home improvement and building products.
hero_kpi_rationale: Net revenue is the primary indicator of the company's financial performance, reflecting its ability to generate sales in the home improvement and building products sector.

kpis.name: Net Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from the sale of products and services.
kpis.description: Net revenue declined 3% in 2025 compared to 2024, primarily due to lower sales volume.
kpis.signal: Decline in overall sales, impacted by volume and foreign exchange effects.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between net revenue and cost of sales, indicating direct product profitability.
kpis.description: Gross margin declined 0.8 percentage points in 2025, impacted by raw material costs, tariffs and lower sales volume.
kpis.signal: Gross margin decline, affected by raw material costs and lower volumes.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by net revenue, measuring profitability of core operations.
kpis.description: Operating margin declined 0.9 percentage points in 2025, affected by the decline in gross margin and an impairment charge.
kpis.signal: Operating margin decline, reflecting pressure on gross margin and exceptional charges.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Total profit after deduction of all expenses, including taxes and interest.
kpis.description: Net income declined 1% in 2025 compared to 2024, primarily due to lower gross profit.
kpis.signal: Slight decline in net income, despite a reduction in expenses.

kpis.name: Plumbing Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of plumbing products.
kpis.description: The plumbing products segment saw sales increase 3% in 2025, driven by higher selling prices.
kpis.signal: Modest growth in plumbing products sales, driven by pricing.

kpis.name: Decorative Products Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of decorative and architectural products.
kpis.description: The architectural decorative products segment experienced a 14% sales decline in 2025, primarily driven by lower volume and the divestiture of the Kichler business.
kpis.signal: Sharp decline in decorative products sales, impacted by volume and divestiture.

kpis.name: Research and Development Expenses
kpis.explanation: Costs incurred for research and development of new products and technologies.
kpis.description: R&D expenses are not explicitly detailed in the provided 10-K.

kpis.name: Selling, General and Administrative Expenses
kpis.explanation: Costs related to sales, marketing, administration and general overhead.
kpis.description: Selling, general and administrative expenses declined 3% in 2025, notably due to the divestiture of the Kichler business.
kpis.signal: Decline in SG&A expenses, partly due to business divestiture.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Amount invested in the acquisition or upgrade of physical assets.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures for 2025 totaled $156 million, compared to $168 million for 2024. The decline reflects the completion of capacity expansion investments in 2024.
kpis.signal: Capital expenditures declined in 2025 compared to 2024, primarily due to reduction in capacity investments.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL across the 8 most recent fiscal years 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $7.562 billion in the most recent year.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Consolidated annual net income, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL across the 8 most recent fiscal years 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Net income of $0.81 billion in the most recent year.

kpis.name: Share Repurchases
kpis.explanation: Number of shares repurchased by the company to reduce outstanding shares.
kpis.description: In 2025, the company repurchased approximately 8.5 million shares for approximately $576 million, demonstrating a commitment to returning capital to shareholders.
kpis.signal: Continued return of value to shareholders through share repurchases.

kpis.name: Dividend Increase
kpis.explanation: Percentage increase in the quarterly dividend paid to shareholders.
kpis.description: The quarterly dividend was increased approximately 7% in 2025 compared to 2024, reflecting confidence in cash flow generation.
kpis.signal: Dividend increase, a sign of confidence in future performance.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Economic Risk and Business Cycles
risks.score_rationale: The company is impacted by economic factors such as consumer confidence, debt and income levels, and interest rates. Business cycles directly affect residential renovation and new construction. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Supplier Dependence and Supply Chain Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on suppliers for raw materials, components and finished goods. Increases in raw material costs and tariffs impacted margins in 2025. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to foreign exchange risk due to its international operations. Foreign exchange effects reduced net sales by $45 million in 2025. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Labor Shortage Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company must attract, develop and retain talented employees to succeed. The availability of skilled workers for repairs and renovations is noted as a key factor. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Intense Competition Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive sector with numerous local and international players. (default score, subject to refinement)
